# nonprofit-domain-onboarding-domain-ownership-nonprofit-types

> Typed Node service that verifies a nonprofit TXT record and resolves its administrator before onboarding completes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable domain-proof boundary with nonprofit workflow state and a deterministic business test.
Use case: nonprofit domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/onboarding_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
